data.name: Rizqah
data.gender_notes: Rizqah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'rizq', meaning 'sustenance' or 'provision'. In Islamic context, it signifies God's bounty and blessings. The name Rizqah carries the meaning “God's provision” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rizqah usually hope their child will grow to embody god's provision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying reliance on God's provision and trust in His plan.
data.etymology: Rizqah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's provision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rizqah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: رزقة
in_arabic.meaning: رزق من الله، الخير و الرزق الوفير من عند الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رزقة مشتق من رزق، يعني الخير و الرزق الذي يأتي من الله تعالى. ورد ذكر الرزق في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'و ما من دابة في الأرض إلا على الله رزقها' (هود: 6). اسم رزقة يدل على معاني الرفاهية و السعادة و الرزق الحلال.

in_urdu.name: رزقہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی طرف سے رزق، وافر خیر و برکت
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام رزقہ عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی طرف سے رزق یا وافر خیر و برکت. قرآن مجید میں رزق کے موضوع پر مختلف آیات ہیں، جیسے: 'و ما من دابة في الأرض إلا على الله رزقها' (هود: 6). نام رزقہ خوشحالی، رفاہیت اور حلال رزق کی علامت ہے.

in_hindi.name: रिज़्क़ा
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर द्वारा प्रदत्त आजीविका, भरपूर आशीर्वाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम रिज़्क़ा की उत्पत्ति العربية मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वर द्वारा प्रदत्त आजीविका या भरपूर आशीर्वाद. कुरआन में रज़्ज़ाक (رزق देने वाला) विशेषता अल्लाह की है. इस्लामी परंपरा में नाम रिज़्क़ा का चयन आशीर्वाद, सुख-समृद्धि और हलाल कमाई की कामना का प्रतीक है.

in_pashto.name: رزقہ
in_pashto.meaning: د الله لخوا رزق، ډیرې ښېګڼې
in_pashto.long_meaning: د رزقہ نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د الله لخوا رزق یا ډیرې ښېګڼې دي. په قرآن کریم کې د رزق په اړه مختلفې آیاتې شته، لکه: 'او څه داسې ژوندی مخلوق نشته، چې په ځمکه کې د الله رزق نه وي' (هود: ۶). د رزقہ نوم د خوښۍ، کامیابۍ او حلال رزق نښه ده.

in_english.name: Rizqah
in_english.meaning: Provision from Allah, abundance of blessings
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rizqah originates from Arabic roots, signifying provision or abundance of blessings from Allah. The concept of rizq is mentioned throughout the Quran, emphasizing Allah's role as the provider. Rizqah symbolizes a life of prosperity, happiness, and lawful earnings. Its historical significance dates back to early Islamic times, reflecting the community's values of faith and sustenance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rizqah carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world, signifying the importance of faith in providing for one's needs. It is a reminder that all provisions come from God and that we should be grateful for His generosity. In many Muslim communities, the name Rizqah is given to children as a way to express hope and prayer for His bountiful provisions in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, the name Rizqah reflects the belief in the Sufi tradition that 'Allah is the Razq ( provider) of the world'. It is a prayerful name that reminds us of our dependence on God for our needs, both material and spiritual. The name inspires a sense of trust and surrender to the divine will, understanding that His provision comes at the right time and in the right way. Through the name Rizqah, one's faith is strengthened by being reminded of God's boundless love and care for His creation.

historical_references.context: Rizqah is the name of the wife of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) uncle, Al-'Abbas ibn 'Abdul-Muttalib.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Rizqah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
